name: Jagged Reef
summary: Along Azshara’s northern coast, ships find no safe passage through Jagged Reef. Sandy beaches meet stone spurs and churning surf, where hydras, makrura, and murlocs prowl.

sections.title: A Perilous Shoreline
sections.body:
Jagged Reef cuts along Azshara’s northern edge. Broken cliffs and jutting stones divide sandy shores into quiet inlets. Beneath the water, crags and shifting shallows make the passage deadly to ships.

On shore, hydras and makrura prowl the surf. Murlocs search the tides for scraps and unwary prey.

faq.q: Where is the Jagged Reef located?
faq.answer: Jagged Reef runs along Azshara’s northern shore, where beaches, rocky spurs, and small ocean inlets meet.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the Jagged Reef?
faq.answer: Hydras, makrura, and murlocs prowl the shallows and sandy beaches of Jagged Reef.

faq.q: Can ships navigate the waters around the Jagged Reef?
faq.answer: No. Underwater rocks and shifting shallows make the waters around Jagged Reef too dangerous for ships.

faq.q: Are there any settlements along the reef?
faq.answer: No civilized settlements lie along Jagged Reef. Murloc encampments are the only organized presence on the shore, apart from passing explorers or hunters.

angles.text: As a hunter, you can study or tame the hydras and shoreline crustaceans on Jagged Reef’s exposed northern beaches.
